The activity requires pulling together payroll structure and benefit allocation data for fiscal review—a data aggregation and reporting task on HR master data. None of the candidates fulfill this need:

- The performance review agents orchestrate *evaluation workflows*, not payroll/benefits data retrieval
- The talent assessment agent manages *employee evaluations*, not compensation structures
- The IT agents (access provisioning, asset provisioning, change management) are entirely unrelated to HR payroll/benefits domains

A meaningful match would be an HR data API or analytics product that exposes payroll and benefits master data, or an HR reporting/analytics agent—none of which are present in this candidate set.
